Atlas Ledger

Append-only audit trail

A lending client needed an immutable record of every underwriting decision. We built a write-once ledger with signed exports and a review queue that a regulator can read without an engineer present.

Clinic scheduler

Booking and reminders

A fictional clinic group needed appointment booking that survives a bad connection. The result is an offline-first form with a deterministic server reconciliation step.
